title: Raw class evaluation commutes with geometric chart pullback
statement: In the commutative-square setting of [def-kun-commutative-exchange-raw-pullback], put V=U×_Y X and V′=U′×_Y′ X′, and let t:V′→V be induced by g′ and U′→U [def-pc-fibre-product]. For every F and q≥0, raw restricted derived-Hom evaluation ev [def-sbc-raw-restricted-cohomology-comparison-map] obeys t*(ev_f(z))=ev_f′(B(z)), where B is raw transport [def-kun-commutative-exchange-raw-pullback] and t* is raw complex cohomology pullback followed by the coefficient comparison (upperStarComp t p)⁻¹ then upperStarComp p′ g′ [def-sbc-raw-affine-restricted-cohomology]. This equality is stated as an equality of additive group morphisms, equivalently the asserted formula on every raw class. It contains no direct-image exchange or higher-image class morphism.

proof.text: The induced square V′→V over g′ is cartesian, regardless of cartesianness of the original square. Construct the inverse to V′→V×_X X′ by the two fibre-product universal properties. The unit formula for restriction along an etale map identifies ordinary sections under this square with global section pullback and the specified coefficient comparison.

The unit form of the underived mate, naturality of the g-unit, and the free represented pullback Hom equivalence show that this ordinary section map carries the represented identity generator for f,U to that for f′,U′. This calculation is independent of degree and of the coefficient target.

Construct derived section pullback from the derived unit for t, the Leray comparison and the derived square of exact restrictions. The derived single-unit identity and its degree-zero comparison identify it with the ordinary section map. On singles, exact restriction composition identifies the coefficient with the specified underived square comparison. Shift compatibility then identifies its map on the q-shifted single with raw complex cohomology pullback followed by that coefficient.

Apply naturality of this derived section transformation to z, precompose with the inverse source single comparison and postcompose with the target shift comparison. Cancel the single comparisons. Evaluate at the inverse zero comparison of the represented generator. The generator identity from the preceding step gives the target raw evaluation, proving the asserted equality on every raw class.

theorem commutativeExchangeEvaluationCompatibility
    {X X' Y Y' : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y} {f' : X' ⟶ Y'}
    {g : Y' ⟶ Y} {g' : X' ⟶ X} (sq : CommSq g' f' f g)
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (q : ℕ) (U : Y.Etale) :
    let t := pullback.map (g.Etale.obj U).hom f' U.hom f
      (pullback.fst U.hom g) g' g
      (pullback.condition (f := U.hom) (g := g)).symm sq.w.symm
    let c : ((t)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]).obj
        (((pullback.snd U.hom f)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]).obj F) ⟶
        ((pullback.snd (g.Etale.obj U).hom f')^*[AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]).obj
          (((g')^*[AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]).obj F) :=
      (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} t (pullback.snd U.hom f)).inv.app F ≫
      (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (pullback.snd (g.Etale.obj U).hom f') g'
        (t ≫ pullback.snd U.hom f) (pullback.lift_snd _ _ _)).hom.app F
    rawRestrictedCohomologyComparison f q F U ≫
      (rawAffineComplexPullback (q : ℤ) t
        ((CochainComplex.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
          (((pullback.snd U.hom f)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]).obj F)) ≫
      (cohomology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (pullback (g.Etale.obj U).hom f') (q : ℤ)).map
        (DerivedCategory.Q.map
          ((((t)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]).mapCochainComplexSingleFunctor 0).hom.app _ ≫
            (CochainComplex.singleFunctor _ 0).map c))) =
      commutativeExchangeRawPullbackMap sq F q U ≫
        rawRestrictedCohomologyComparison f' q _ (g.Etale.obj U)
